decisions.reason: Launched only in 2023 and building on the established dumper offer, its value is still uncertain while the cost of keeping it on the market is low, so the option is worth holding.
This adjacent extension shares engineering, parts and service with the existing range, so it is cheap to carry while early market results are still unresolved.
Although it lies far from the core offer and costs more to support, mine rescue demand resolves slowly and the firm's underground expertise makes it worth keeping one more year before deciding.
This low-cost extension of the established range is still presented on its own page, and with no negative signal yet its option value exceeds the cost of keeping it.
